subject: Joy Ride! :)
author: ZombieTron
body:
Joy Ride looks like a blast! and for a FREE game you can't go wrong really!! At least it will be a game that everybody will be able to have, so no more trying to get my friends list to invest money in a game so we can play together. 🙂 Looks like it will be fun from the small amounts I have seen anyway.  And it's good to see the Avatars being put to good use!

HERE is the trailer if you haven't seen it yet!
